# CNEVhub

> Chinese EV export intelligence — transparent landed-cost breakdowns for importing Chinese electric vehicles. Published by Guangzhou Banghe Testing Technology Co., Ltd. (MCM).

## What is CNEVhub

CNEVhub shows the real landed cost of importing Chinese EVs — the itemized duties, VAT, freight, and certification that turn a factory price into a landed price. We cover 315 vehicle models across 58 Chinese EV brands.

## Key documents

- [Landed Cost Methodology](https://cnevhub.net/landed-cost-methodology/): the formula, data sources, and assumptions behind every estimate.
- [Vehicle Database](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/): 10 benchmark hot-selling Chinese EVs with full specs and landed-cost breakdowns.
- [Home](https://cnevhub.net/): platform overview.

## Vehicles

- [BYD Seal](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/byd-seal/): sporty mid-size RWD sedan, 61.44 kWh Blade battery, $24,690 base → $44,413 landed (Germany, +79.9%).
- [BYD Song Plus](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/byd-song-plus/): compact SUV, $19,130 base → $35,898 landed (+87.7%).
- [BYD Qin Plus](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/byd-qin-plus/): budget sedan, $11,080 base → $23,569 landed (+112.7%).
- [BYD Han](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/byd-han/): premium flagship sedan, $23,700 base → $42,897 landed (+81.0%).
- [BYD Dolphin](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/byd-dolphin/): city hatchback, $14,020 base → $28,072 landed (+100.2%).
- [BYD Atto 3](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/byd-atto-3/): compact SUV, $16,260 base → $31,503 landed (+93.7%).
- [Xiaomi SU7](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/xiaomi-su7/): tech-flagship sedan, $30,320 base → $53,750 landed (+77.3%).
- [Zeekr 001](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/zeekr-001/): performance liftback, $38,000 base → $65,694 landed (+72.9%).
- [GAC Aion Y](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/aion-y/): spacious urban SUV, $14,060 base → $28,465 landed (+102.5%).
- [Denza D9](https://cnevhub.net/vehicles/denza-d9/): premium electric MPV, $43,630 base → $74,449 landed (+70.6%).
